definitions.explanation: A jump-rope game in which two people swing a long rope while several others jump together inside it. A common schoolyard and sports-day activity in Japan.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}{縄|なわ}{跳|と}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大|おお}{縄|なわ}{跳|と}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: The whole class took on the long-rope jumping record together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大|おお}{縄|なわ}{跳|と}び⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{跳|と}ぶ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: In the long-rope jumping at sports day, it's important to jump in sync with each other.

notes:
A cooperative version of ⟦{縄跳|なわと}び→縄跳び：06323_nawatobi⟧ in which a long rope is turned by two people while a group jumps together. Often a team event at school ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧ (sports days).
